name: Can Frasheski Construction match existing board materials and finishes?
description: We prioritize matching existing materials and finishes. We source closely resembling materials and discuss options if an exact match isn't possible.

mainEntity.name: Can Frasheski Construction match existing board materials and finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching existing board materials and finishes is a priority for us to ensure a cohesive appearance. We source materials that closely resemble your current boards in type, size, and texture. While an exact match might occasionally be challenging for older or custom materials, we strive to achieve the closest possible aesthetic and functional integration. We discuss material options and potential variations with you during the planning phase, offering a Practical Tradeoff between exact replication and available, durable materials.
